reference.prompt: Use case: lighting-weather. Asset type: AAA multiplayer FPS environment art target, photorealistic architectural paintover. Edit the supplied actual game screenshot of Lowtide, a North German Speicherstadt tidal port. Preserve its exact camera, warehouse silhouettes, all window and doorway positions, canal low tide level, exposed banks, central barge, railings and stairs, gameplay routes and dimensions. Elevate material realism and visual cohesion to contemporary high-budget shooter environment quality. A clearing coastal afternoon after rain, soft warm directional sunlight and cool restrained sky fill, readable shadow detail, subtle distant atmospheric perspective. Rich but muted old red brick, very fine authentic roughness, irregular salt efflorescence and soot under sills, dark moisture and green algae at the low tide line. Weathered cut sandstone kerbs and plinths, damp granular muddy banks with naturally scattered small stones and timber debris, narrow reflective green-grey water with fine irregular ripples. Add believable small-scale cast iron drainpipes with metal joints, masonry anchor plates and a few restrained warehouse number plates where physically appropriate. Surfaces have varied wear at edges and plausible construction thickness. Grounded lighting, nuanced contact shadows, real material response. No bloom haze, no orange-teal grading, no volumetric shafts, no bokeh, no game HUD, no people, no text overlays, no new large buildings or layout changes. Landscape frame.

mud.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: seamless PBR base-color texture for a high-quality 3D North German tidal harbour environment. Square orthographic top-down material scan of compact damp estuary silt, brown-grey dark taupe clay mud with scattered tiny dark river gravel, crushed pale oyster-shell fragments and very fine natural irregular sediment runnels. Covers approximately 1.6m by 1.6m. Mostly dense fine granular silt, some darker moisture mottling but not blue; no grass, no large stones, no footprints, no large cracks, no standing reflective water. Extremely realistic fine material detail. Flat diffuse cross-polarized illumination, no baked shadows or highlights, no perspective. Seamless and tileable at all four edges. Entire canvas filled edge to edge. No text, no borders, no labels, no objects. Restrained neutral desaturated earthy colours.
mud.technical_processing: Power-of-two 2048 bake; shallow derived normal and roughness; original source preserved.
